messages:
nina: seeing a surge of warm-pool failures in sa-1 since ~05:10 UTC. Nodes failing keystore decrypt and aborting bootstrap. Warm pool kept spawning -> GPU churn.

pablo: any error lines?

nina: node-agent log: 
```
[2026-06-10T05:11:03Z] keystore: decrypt failed: KMS:AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:iam::999:role/infra-node-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:sa-1:111:key/abcd1234
[2026-06-10T05:11:03Z] bootstrap: attestation failed, aborting
```

ops-bot: Alert: 52 nodes failed bootstrap in south-america-1 (>4m). Warm-pool growth high.

deepa: security rolled out a KMS key policy tighten at 03:00 to restrict decrypt to a specific external-account principal. Did we expect cross-account assume for nodes?

nina: our nodes assume a cross-account node-role to hit the keystore; the new KMS policy removed that account principal. Also noticed NAT GW route table change earlier which blocked outbound to keystore proxy in another VPC. So double block.

cost-bot: estimate: if churn continues 1h -> ~900 GPU-min (~$1.3k). Recommend immediate mitigation.

pablo: mitigation plan: 1) patch KMS policy to re-add infra-node-role principal for keystore decrypt 2) restore NAT GW route for keystore proxy 3) pause warm-pool autoscaling + restart stuck agents in batches 4) post-incident lockstep for policy changes. Who can take 1 & 2?

deepa: I can push an emergency KMS policy update (temp allow) and file the formal policy PR. Nina, can you check routing?

nina: I'll revert the route change. Quick commands: ``aws kms put-key-policy --key-id arn:aws:kms:sa-1:111:key/abcd1234 --policy file://temp-allow-node-role.json`` and ``aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0aa1b2c3 --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --gateway-id nat-0a1b2c3``

ops-bot: Note: INC-5078 created: SA keystore decrypt failures due to KMS key policy + nat route change.

pablo: while you do that, I'll set warm-pool.max-size=current and scale-in-protection off for stuck ones. Also will batch restart 10 nodes to clear backoff.

deepa: patched KMS policy to re-allow infra-node-role (temp). Confirmed keystore audit shows Accept for recent decrypts.

nina: route restored. Flow logs show ACCEPT to keystore-proxy endpoints. Node-agent logs now show successful decrypts and attestation progressing.

cost-bot: projection updated: after mitigation estimated extra is ~150 GPU-min (~$220).

pablo: restarted batch 1/5, seeing nodes finish bootstrap. Monitoring warm-pool growth and slot churn.

nina: quick postmortem actions: 1) add policy deployment checklist that includes infra-role acceptance and cross-account principals 2) add gating that prevents route table changes if active warm-pool >0 3) add metric: keystore.decrypt.accept_rate within 30s and alert threshold 0.5% drop. I'll own 2 & 3.

deepa: I'll own 1 and drive the formal KMS policy PR to tighten with explicit testing. Also adding a presubmit that simulates cross-account decrypt.

pablo: closing the incident to monitoring. INC-5078 updated with owners and follow-ups. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
